bofa-equals-bank-of: Case misreads the spec. ALIASES bofa -> ("=bank of", "bofa"): only the first root carries "=". The second root "bofa" is longer than 3 characters, not GENERIC and has no "=", so step 2 gives it its prefix family; "bofa securities" is its only candidate, so the JSA-103 one-word rule keeps it. Expected hits are Bank of America + BofA Securities (150 / 1500), which is what the code returns — and what the JSA-098 audit checked by hand (BANK OF AMERICA N.A.; BOFA SECURITIES, INC.).
